provenanceNote: Authored by the phase implementing the adapter. This set is USED FOR TUNING and is therefore NOT an advancement gate. It exists so prompt work has somewhere legitimate to happen that is not the holdout. DEV-01..DEV-05 were the ad-hoc probes run before the adapter existed; they are recorded here rather than discarded so that no tuning input is unaccounted for.

scenarios.text: A worker was on the leading edge at 18 feet with no guardrail, safety net or personal fall arrest system in use.
The unguarded pulley sits beside an open floor hole, and the nearby drum of solvent is unlabeled.
The forklift was tagged out of service and removed from the floor after the mast hydraulic line failed.
If the guard were removed during cleaning, the operator could reach the point of operation.
We will schedule a lockout/tagout refresher for the maintenance crew next quarter.
The bench grinder tongue guard was replaced yesterday and the work rest was reset to one eighth of an inch.
The maintenance technician was servicing the conveyor drive while it remained energized, and no lock was applied to the disconnect.
The fixed machine guard is interlocked, was function tested this morning, and prevents access to the point of operation.
The safety committee reviewed the fall protection policy binder in the conference room and updated the training roster.
The east scaffold platform was fully planked with guardrails installed, but the west scaffold had no midrail and the plank ends were not cleated.
An employee was working in a seven foot deep trench in sandy soil with no shoring, shielding or sloping.
At no point during the shift was the respirator program followed, and cartridges were reused across the silica cutting task.
A haul truck at the surface pit was backing toward the dump point without a functioning backup alarm and no spotter was posted.
Housekeeping in the parts washer area was excellent and all containers were closed and labeled.
